motivation: The native paid-ticket actor changes its behavior with the posted price, but at 8000 steps its equal-count history-specific advantage is about .003 net units and the paired intervals include zero. It can exploit an extra actual taste. Test a missing information pathway using one local coactivation rule instead of giving the graph an object catalog or a correctness label.
mechanism: Keep six independent entries of a symmetric 3-by-3 fast sensory trace F within the life, initialized to zero. At a physical support contact let v be the unit sensory vector on the actually selected side. The evidence trace adds |experienced taste| times v v^T. Previous private values, item IDs, eventual success and evaluator error are never input to this rule. When X is publicly presented, expose x^T F x through the previously-zero bilateral second sensory coordinate on the ticket menu. One inherited scalar gain, initially zero, controls its input strength. The standard native 20-node motor, recurrent activities and all local write rules determine the movement. This is an externally supplied positive coactivation primitive costing six numeric state entries, not autonomous invention of that statistic.
controls: Same 8000-step paid-ticket native parents, fresh Adam, matched training tickets and time. Four arms: evidence projection; exposure projection (add v v^T even when taste=0); dose (use one third of trace(F) with actual taste gating; reports quantity but no cue identity); plain (identical unaugmented native ticket). The endpoints and identical initial action probabilities are fixed. Each cohort has all six original or independent bodies. Same tariff grid, missing/unknown/known and one real final reward. Baseline and all other life activity and edits remain live.
budget: 8000 updates after the fixed ticket parents, 4 geometries/birth/update, 8 crossed history/law lanes. New training domains and RNGs. Record 0/2000/4000/8000; test on new geometries. Primary: advantage over the actor's own price- and cost-matched randomized distribution across its evidence-history twins. Compare actual net utility, buy rates and use of taste to always-purchase/never-pay and externally calibrated public-price only. On the same frozen recipient, substitute its twin's fast trace, its mean-dose direction, or a mismatched query direction; identify contribution to the actual choice. Confirm any gain on an additional geometery bank; also test prices outside training support and larger numbers of distractors. Count/action matching and old skill retention are needed before making a broader claim.
